card.name: Start of words like artemether and armodafinil
card.fires_on: The first letters 'Ar' or 'ar' at the start of a drug or medical word, such as artemether, artemisinin, armodafinil or arthralgia. Also fires on a few other word openings like 'her' in herbal.

modes.label: Ar- drug names
modes.description: Opening 'Ar' or 'ar' of artemether, artemisinin or armodafinil, often after a colon, 'and' or 'called'.
modes.example: Caution is warranted when co-administering etravirine tablets and<< ar>>temether/lumefantrine

modes.label: Other word openings
modes.description: Opening pieces of other words, such as 'her' in herbal or 'ER' in a product name, plus a stray digit in a year.
modes.example: botanical (<<her>>bal) products, and inhibitors and indu
